execution_bottleneck: The exact source gate resolves +12 and +64 causal-availability timestamps row by row. The pinned ExactBatchClient can resolve arbitrary exact block numbers in JSON-RPC batches of 40, but the source loop does not prefill that cache, so dispersed events can create thousands of sequential requests without changing the scientific source result.

correction.method: sort the already decoded and deduplicated rows once, collect every unique block_number+12 and block_number+64, resolve those exact block numbers in deterministic batches of 40 through the existing ExactBatchClient._post_batch method, populate the unchanged exact timestamp cache, then execute the original event-construction loop
correction.fallback: if a batch request fails, preserve the existing exact per-block block_timestamp path and its REST fallback
correction.scientific_output: unchanged event identities, amounts, timestamps, 12/64-block availability, source gates, hashes of scientific inputs, model, labels, costs, account rules and stage boundaries

unchanged: USDT Issue/Redeem and USDC zero-address Transfer semantics
all 36 fixed source months and source density thresholds
one pooled model and frozen features/hyperparameters
structural first-passage payoff and no elapsed-time liquidation
one global slot and 12/18/24bp account paths
